s10.delivered_answer: I couldn't verify that from the retrieved evidence. According to www.hyundai.com, additionally, the page notes that certain automatic trims such as SX (O), SX Tech, King, and King Knight get smart cruise control with stop and go instead of standard cruise control.

sentences.text: According to Hyundai's features page, wireless phone charging is not standard on every trim, as the front charger is listed from SX onwards and the rear wireless charger only appears on King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.
Standard cruise control is also not included on every trim; it is listed starting from S(O) up through Lounge Edition, while the E, EX, and EX(O) trims do not include it.
Additionally, the page notes that certain automatic trims such as SX (O), SX Tech, King, and King Knight get smart cruise control with stop and go instead of standard cruise control.
According to the Hyundai page, smartphone wireless charging is not standard on every trim, being listed as standard on SX, SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.
Cruise control is also not standard on every trim, as the page lists it as standard on S(O), S(O) Knight, SX, SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.
Additionally, the website notes that automatic versions of SX (O), SX Tech, King, and King Knight receive smart cruise control with stop and go instead of standard cruise control.

s11.delivered_answer: According to the features page on www.hyundai.com, rear AC vents are standard across all listed trims: E, EX, EX(O), S(O), S(O) Knight, SX, SX Premium, King, King Knight, and Lounge Edition.
